metadata.note: 1988 European, without catalyst. Each bank's four steel primaries, of unequal lengths, join one riser to its turbine (0.70, 0.46, 0.36 and 0.58 m in each bank's firing order, x 40 mm from 35 mm; riser 0.14 m x 51 mm). Each turbine is its throat (0.08 m x 27.6 mm, the 959's estimate) and a room 0.12 m x 150 mm after it, the one form of every turbine here; the pipe between the manifolds and the wastegate are not written. From each turbine a pipe to the one transverse silencer, the two about 0.10 m apart in length (0.22 and 0.32 m x 62 mm); the silencer, about 0.52 m x 220 mm with the two pipes entering at its middle, is written as its two halves as one (0.26 m x 311 mm, 19.8 L, 6.7 times the displacement) with the wool, the one expansion chamber; its two tails (about 0.48 m) as one of their combined area (102 mm). Lengths and diameters are estimates from eurospares' parts diagrams, a photograph of silencer 136399 and Tubi Style's replacement's dimensions (about +-20 %). The pipes' diameters are the real car's inner diameters times 1.14, the primaries' included; the expansion chambers' (silencers' bodies') sizes and places, the 1.14 and the 20 mm of wool were set by ear (K, 2026-11-22). Lengths are in steps of 0.02 m. Valve: two exhaust valves per cylinder, 26 mm each (FIA form B-293, as read by the stage auditor), written as one valve of their combined area, 36.8 mm (lift taken as at least 6.5 mm); open about 280 deg, from 54 BBDC / 10 ATDC at 0.5 mm (an owner's manual as quoted on a forum, read as the Testarossa's).
